text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash wanted to do some shopping, 
so we stopped by the mall on the way back.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer. For making you keep me 
company.
choice_data_list: By the way, what are you planning to buy?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to buy gifts of gratitude for the 
people who take care of me in Japan. So 
I've been saving up money in my piggy 
bank.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I've already made a shopping list, so it 
shouldn't take up too much of your time. 
—Shall we, then?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...A sound-sleep pillow for Falcon-san, 
and this pouch for Jordan-san..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
For Golshi-san, this Moai statue 
ornament... and for Nakayama-san, a pewter 
tumbler...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
――Now then. That just leaves one person's 
share. Though, it was considerably cheaper 
than the estimated budget...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: That is, of course... a gift for you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I cannot allow that. You are the one who 
has looked after me the most, after all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Since we have some leeway in the budget 
now, if you'd like, I'd love to hear your 
preferences before making a decision—
choice_data_list:
I want to look around at different options 
before deciding.

Anything is fine, as long as it's 
something you picked!
Anything you pick for me is fine!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Since we have some leeway in the budget 
now, if you'd like, I'd love to hear your 
preferences before making a decision—
choice_data_list:
I want to look around at different options 
before deciding.

Anything is fine, as long as it's 
something you picked!
Anything you pick for me is fine!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Then let us look around 
together, just the two of us.

After wandering around the store for a 
bit... I noticed Eishin Flash staring 
intently at a particular item.

Looking at it, it was a stopwatch 
decorated with a ladybug. Come to think of 
it, she always did love ladybugs—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. My apologies. I was momentarily 
distracted—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Trainer, did you use this stopwatch 
too—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Please wait. ...Could this be... for my 
sake...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I understand. You're as kind as ever, 
aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"However, I really do want to give you a 
present of my own. It's a token of my 
gratitude."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "...I appreciate the sentiment, but—"
choice_data_list: Let's count that joy as our gift.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I under... stand. Then, I shall take 
advantage of your kindness..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to treasure and use this 
well.

Glad that she liked it, I had Eishin Flash 
wait a moment while I went ahead to pay 
the bill.

Right after leaving the shop, I gave the 
present to Eishin Flash.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Please wait. Before that—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Please, accept this.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Please open it.

Urged to open it... Inside is a picture 
frame.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I really wanted to give you a tangible 
keepsake of my own, too."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"There is a particular photograph I would 
love for you to display in that frame."
choice_data_list: What kind of photo is it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
This is... a photo commemorating our race 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"That is proof that I have fulfilled the 
duty I must perform—and I believe it will 
be the gift that brings you the greatest 
joy."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Please look forward to it—

After receiving a wonderful gift from 
Eishin Flash, we pledged once more to keep 
doing our best together.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Anything... you say? Still, I would like 
to choose an item that will bring the 
utmost joy, so—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —No. That is quite a difficult problem.
choice_data_list: You don't have to overthink it that much—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Please wait a moment. Within 12 minutes 
and 30 seconds, I am certain to find the 
ideal item for you.

...Having said that, Eishin Flash left 
before I could stop her.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...7 minutes and 18 seconds left. 
Hmm—nothing is really catching my eye...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Don't panic. Toi, toi, toi... Let me 
check the floor map and think—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aah! I knew it was you, Flash-san! 
Yoo-hoo~♪ What a coincidence~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? Flash-san, all by yourself? 
I thought you said this morning that you 
were going out with your Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Falcon-san. That's true, but actually, 
right now—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see~... A present for 
Trainer-san, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
“—Trainer, you once mentioned that you 
really liked that Arita-ware teacup you 
saw on TV...”

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...During that special program on 
Scandinavia, you also mentioned that the 
table lamp looked stylish—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
In that case, the presumed answer is... 
No, could there be other— hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: H-Hmm... Aren't you overthinking it a bit?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, we've hit a bottleneck... There 
are 5 minutes and 28 seconds left. Will we 
be able to find the optimal item in 
time...?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Let's see. Flash-san, at times like 
this, you see—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —Thank you for waiting, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: This is... a gift for you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Inside is... a cake. As the daughter of a 
cake shop owner, I bought it from a place 
I can recommend with absolute confidence.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that, um... you'll find the 
flavor to be quite satisfactory.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ......Um. Did you... enjoy it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...! What a relief...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Ooh~! So she loved it then! Way to go, 
Flash-san!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It went exactly as Falcon-san 
advised.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mufufu~ Exactly~ At times like this, what 
matters isn't finding a perfect 100-point 
answer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The most important thing is to convey your 
true feelings. That was so very true...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I hope they're enjoying eating it right 
about now..."
